ground_vehicles.name: Mining Crawler
ground_vehicles.notes: One lands with the colony pod. Drives to a deposit, unfurls and mines it anywhere on the map, sending each full hopper home by cargo pod. Can break down while mining (minor fault to explosion) and must be repaired on the Colony Hub's repair pad. Surface stats in surfaces.json.

ground_vehicles.name: Mk I Scout
ground_vehicles.notes: Mk I Scout. Two land with the colony pod; maps the deposits around it. Surface stats in surfaces.json.

ground_vehicles.name: Mk II Surveyor
ground_vehicles.notes: Survey rover Mk II: faster, surveys a wider area. Built at the Vehicle Bay. Surface stats in surfaces.json.

ground_vehicles.name: Mk III Explorer
ground_vehicles.notes: Survey rover Mk III: the fastest, widest survey. Built at the Vehicle Bay. Surface stats in surfaces.json.

ground_vehicles.name: Construction Rover
ground_vehicles.notes: Built at the Vehicle Bay. Carries a folded Colony Hub and an exocomp dock: drives to a site at least 8 tiles from your other bases, unfolds and is used up as the new hub, which its exocomps then build. The ground route to a second base (the orbital one is the outpost drop). Surface stats in surfaces.json.
